summary.text: Christopher Ireland is the Republican candidate for the Rhode Island House of Representatives, District 7, where he faces Democrat Amy Santiago in the November 3, 2026 general election.
He ran for the same seat as an independent in 2022 and lost to incumbent David Morales.

paragraphs.text: In a 2022 Ballotpedia survey, Christopher Ireland said he had lived in Providence for about 20 years, in the Mount Pleasant, Valley and Elmhurst neighborhoods, and that he is a homeowner, business owner, husband and father.
He said then that he was running as an independent because he believes in policy over party, and that his first-term priorities would be education, the business environment, and housing.
